subject.title: feat(cursor): add token cost report with Cursor-metered total

question: Should CodexBar require explicit opt-in before fetching detailed Cursor usage-event history, or treat existing Cursor authentication plus the cost-summary setting as sufficient consent?
rationale: This expands an existing summary-status integration into authenticated, account-wide event-history collection through a private endpoint, so implementation correctness cannot decide the acceptable privacy and consent contract.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Add a dedicated consent setting and clear account-wide remote-data wording while preserving summary-only behavior for existing users by default.

options.title: Reuse existing consent
options.body: Treat the existing Cursor cookie configuration and cost-summary toggle as authorization for detailed dashboard event collection, with prominent documentation.

options.title: Keep Cursor summary-only
options.body: Decline detailed event-history collection and retain the existing status and quota integration.

recommendation.title: Require explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Add a dedicated consent setting and clear account-wide remote-data wording while preserving summary-only behavior for existing users by default.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner explicitly requested this decision and has already reviewed and modified the affected auth and cost paths.
